{{Article header|section=EDFM|context=Community|deck=Discord information, moderation, onboarding, and community-management bot for EDFM.}}

'''CMDR Fima''' is the Discord companion to the ''Elite Dangerous Field Manual'' (EDFM). It provides EDFM information lookup, supported ''Elite Dangerous'' data integrations, moderation tools, verification, role management, onboarding, and other community-management functions for the official EDFM Discord.

CMDR Fima is currently operated primarily for the official EDFM Discord server. The bot is part of the EDFM project and uses the official EDFM website at [https://edfieldmanual.com edfieldmanual.com].

== What CMDR Fima does ==

CMDR Fima supports several community functions:

* looking up EDFM articles and selected structured information from the wiki;
* displaying supported commodity and market information from implemented Elite Dangerous data providers;
* helping members complete Discord Rules Screening and server verification;
* managing self-assignable role panels;
* giving authorized staff tools for warnings, mutes, kicks, bans, unbans, message purging, channel locks, staff notes, and moderation cases;
* sending moderation, message, and member log entries to configured staff log channels where those logs are enabled.

CMDR Fima is a staff tool and community utility. It is not an autonomous AI moderation judge. Warnings and ordinary moderation actions are issued by authorized human moderators. The current warning workflow may automatically apply the configured mute role when a member reaches the configured warning threshold, which is currently three active warnings.
